heroText: KalaUdaan AI connects India's traditional artisans with the world through technology while preserving the stories, skills and heritage behind every creation.
weaverText: From the loom to the finished fabric, every thread carries a story. Our weavers keep centuries-old techniques alive, creating beautiful handloom fabrics that are more than products — they are pieces of heritage.
potterText: From earth to art, our potters shape stories in clay. Each piece is a celebration of tradition, skill and creativity passed down through generations.
artisanText: From intricate designs to handcrafted treasures, our artisans bring culture, skill and passion to life. Every creation is a masterpiece of tradition, made with love and care.
handloomText: Every weave carries a memory. Every pattern carries a place. Every creation carries a maker.
voiceStorefront: Your voice can become your storefront.
finalText: Discover the makers. Support their craft. Carry the tradition forward.

privacyIntro: This prototype privacy notice explains what information KalaUdaan AI may use to operate the marketplace and improve the user experience.
privacyCollectionText: We may store account details, seller profile information, product information, wishlist/cart state and support requests that you enter into the prototype.
privacyUseText: Information is used to operate product discovery, cart and wishlist features, seller tools, verification flows, notifications and support features.
privacySharingText: We do not sell personal information in this prototype. If a future production service uses third-party providers, the relevant data practices should be disclosed before activation.
privacyChoicesText: You can remove saved browser data such as cart, wishlist and profile information through the browser storage controls or by using the relevant product controls.
privacySecurityText: The prototype keeps most demo state in browser storage. Do not enter passwords, identity documents or other sensitive information into a demo deployment unless a secure backend is configured.
privacyContactText: For privacy questions, contact support@kalaudaan.ai and include enough context for the platform team to locate the issue.
termsIntro: These marketplace terms describe the basic rules for using KalaUdaan AI as a prototype for buyers, sellers and artisans.
termsUseText: Use KalaUdaan AI lawfully, respectfully and only for genuine marketplace, craft discovery and seller activities.
termsAccountsText: Keep account information accurate. You are responsible for activity performed through your account in a production deployment.
termsProductsText: Sellers should provide accurate product names, materials, prices, images, stock and craft information. AI-generated fields must be reviewed before publishing.
termsPaymentsText: The current prototype provides a checkout demonstration. It does not process real payments unless a secure payment provider is explicitly integrated.
termsSellerText: Product publishing is gated by KalaUdaan AI seller verification in the prototype. This screening is a platform feature and not a government certification.
termsReturnsText: Production return, cancellation and refund rules must be configured before launch. The prototype records the relevant user action without processing a real refund.
termsLiabilityText: The prototype may use demo data and local browser storage. Production deployments need secure authentication, backend validation, payments, moderation and operational support.
termsChangesText: Marketplace policies may change as the service evolves. A production deployment should publish the effective date and notify users of material changes.
policyDemoNote: Prototype policy: these pages are an original KalaUdaan AI draft informed by common marketplace sections such as help, payments, returns, privacy, security and terms. They are not a copy of Amazon or Flipkart legal text and should be reviewed before production launch.
